Gives the handle of the desktop, the group that top level windows live in. Pass it as the group of [CreateWindow](CreateWindow). With [ClientWidth](ClientWidth) and [ClientHeight](ClientHeight) it tells the size of the screen. [DesktopBuffer](DesktopBuffer) is what you draw to if you want to paint on it.

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 32, 2
win = CreateWindow("Centered", 0, 0, 180, 100, Desktop(), 15)
SetGadgetShape win, (ClientWidth(Desktop()) - 180) / 2, (ClientHeight(Desktop()) - 100) / 2, 180, 100
Repeat
Until WaitEvent() = $803
```
@returns A handle that stands for the desktop.
@gap The windows are drawn in the program's own window, which has the size you gave `Graphics`, even though [ClientWidth](ClientWidth) and [ClientHeight](ClientHeight) tell the size of the screen. Windows cannot be placed outside of the program's window.
